## Design Choice Checklist
- [ ] **Explainability preserved:** Ticket classifier remains deterministic without unexplainable black-box guessing.
- [ ] **Privacy preserved:** Teachers see only category and status; student grievance body remains confidential.
- [ ] **Human-in-the-loop preserved:** No attendance records are modified automatically without explicit faculty sign-off.
- [ ] **Automated tests pass:** `npm test` passes 100%.
